About this text

Text: Book T as printed in The Equinox Vol. I No. 8 (London, September 1912), pp. 143–210, published by Aleister Crowley. Public domain. Transcription checked against the scan of the 1912 issue; where they differed, the printed page was followed.

Where the printed page sets astrological signs inside a sentence, the text here spells them out; the tables keep the signs. Hebrew is in Hebrew letters. The coloured frontispiece plate (p. 144) is not reproduced.

Everything set apart in dashed boxes, the chips under each card heading, the card pictures (Rider-Waite-Smith, 1909) and the links are this site's, not Book T's.
